business_problem: J&T Cargo needed a trustworthy partner to build a robust computing cluster and data-warehouse-ready logistics platform that could keep up with pandemic-era e-commerce growth, real-time parcel tracking expectations, warehousing demand, and cross-border shipping complexity.
solution_summary: J&T Cargo built its shipment-tracking and supply-chain platform on a microservices architecture running on Alibaba Cloud. Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) provides the main cloud-native runtime, while Microservices Engine helps the company operate service-to-service connectivity and governance across logistics applications. ApsaraDB RDS, ApsaraDB for Redis, and PolarDB give the platform managed storage layers for transactional data, cached state, and high-scale relational persistence, and DCDN improves delivery performance and protection for Internet-facing traffic. The architecture lets J&T Cargo scale computing resources as demand changes with seasonality and e-commerce surges, which is essential for a network that spans warehouses, delivery operations, and customer-tracking services. The company positions this as a foundation for broader big-data and AI work, pairing operational applications with a data platform capable of supporting high performance, availability, scalability, and cost control across Indonesia's growing cargo market.
business_outcome: J&T Cargo gained a scalable and more cost-efficient logistics platform for shipment tracking, warehousing, and supply-chain operations under rising e-commerce demand.

DCDN provides edge acceleration and protection for Internet-facing traffic

solution_components.name: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK)
solution_components.role: Runs the cloud-native microservices that power shipment-tracking and supply-chain applications.

solution_components.name: Microservices Engine (MSE)
solution_components.role: Provides managed microservice governance capabilities across logistics services.

solution_components.name: ApsaraDB RDS
solution_components.role: Stores operational relational data for logistics transactions and service workflows.

solution_components.name: ApsaraDB for Redis
solution_components.role: Caches latency-sensitive logistics data for fast application response.

solution_components.name: PolarDB
solution_components.role: Adds scalable relational persistence for high-volume operational workloads.

solution_components.name: DCDN
solution_components.role: Accelerates and protects Internet-facing content and APIs at the edge.

data_flow: Shipment and supply-chain requests are handled by microservices on ACK and MSE, write operational state to RDS, Redis, and PolarDB, and expose tracking and service traffic through DCDN for faster and more resilient access.
